newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE MORNING FIX LATE DUE TO TECHNICAL CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE MORNING FIX LATE DUE TO TECHNICAL CHANGE.

text.p: The Riga bourse said on Monday its morning price fix would be late due to technical innovations, with computerised trading being introduced starting from today.
"We expect todays reopening results at around 1300 (1000GMT)," a bourse spokeswoman told Reuters.

"We warned our clients on Friday that the bourse might be slightly late with the morning price fix results this week due to the introduction of the new computerised trading software AS400," she added.
The new system will enable brokers to trade from their offices and place orders electronically through an on-line system.
